chapter: Garland on the New Orleans style
title: Playing soft and sweet: shading the music and Bud Scott
summary: Garland describes the old band's dynamics, the 'soft and sweet' reputation, and the rhythm he and Bud Scott kept.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I wondered, did you ever work out any routines of playing, say, the first chorus loud or the introduction loud and then the next part soft?
